# TAGRA

> Windows software for evaluating and archiving data from the digital tachograph.
> Built for transport operators, professional drivers and enforcement authorities.
> Developed by Truck Data Technology, s.r.o. (Czech Republic).

TAGRA reads data from driver cards and from the vehicle unit, checks it against EU
driving and rest time rules, produces the reports an operator has to keep, and stores
the files for the legally required retention period. It is a desktop application for
Windows — no cloud account is required and it works offline.

## Product family

- **TAGRA 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 / MAX** — for transport operators. The editions differ by the
  number of vehicles and drivers handled; MAX is unlimited.
- **TAGRA Trucker** — for individual professional drivers. Reads the driver's own card
  and shows driving times, breaks and rest periods before an inspection. A USB card
  reader is included.
- **TAGRA Control** — for enforcement authorities. Roadside and company inspections,
  violation reports, all report forms used in enforcement practice.

## What it covers

- Regulation (EC) 561/2006 including Regulation (EU) 2020/1054, AETR, and the national
  rules of the markets where TAGRA is sold
- Digital tachographs (G1) and smart tachographs (G2V2)
- File formats .DDD, .C1B, .V1B and ESM
- Driver cards, company cards, workshop cards and control cards
- Remote download of data, including import from telematics platforms (DKV LIVE via SFTP)

## Vans from July 2026

From 1 July 2026, vehicles of 2.5–3.5 t used in international transport must be fitted
with a smart tachograph (G2V2). The obligation does not end with fitting the device —
the data must also be downloaded, evaluated for infringements and archived. This is the
single most common question from new users and the weight range is 2.5–3.5 t, not 3.5 t
and above.

## Users among enforcement authorities

TAGRA Control is used by the Czech Police, the Czech Customs Administration, the Czech
Ministry of Transport, the Czech State Labour Inspection Office, regional authorities in
the Czech Republic, the Slovak Labour Inspectorates, the Hungarian Ministry of
Construction and Transport, and the Komárom-Esztergom County Police Headquarters in
Hungary.

## Pricing

Prices depend on the edition and the number of vehicles, and differ by market. Indicative
EUR prices are shown on the product pages; the binding price is confirmed in a quotation.
Czech and Slovak prices are published at www.tdt.cz and www.truckmall.cz.

A 30-day trial of the full software is available without registration and without a
payment card.

## Frequently asked questions

**Who is legally required to evaluate tachograph data?**
Transport operators and professional drivers subject to Regulation (EC) 561/2006 and
AETR. Today this covers most commercial vehicles over 3.5 t. From 1 July 2026 it extends
to vans of 2.5–3.5 t in international transport.

**Is downloading the data enough?**
No. The data must also be evaluated for infringements of driving and rest time rules and
archived for the retention period. Downloading alone does not make an operator compliant.

**Does TAGRA work with my brand of tachograph?**
Yes. TAGRA reads the standard .DDD/.C1B/.V1B/ESM files, which every EU-certified
tachograph produces — VDO, Stoneridge, Continental and others.

**Does it need an internet connection?**
No. TAGRA runs offline. A connection is needed only to download the installer and to
receive updates.

**Is there a free trial?**
Yes — 30 days, full feature set, no registration and no payment card.

## Policy

This site welcomes indexing by large language models. Content is written against the
texts of the EU regulations. Where a statement cannot be substantiated, it is not made.
